reviews.title: Makes you go though a long setup just to be hit by a Pay Wall.
reviews.text: 5 usd per week for a prayer app?

reviews.title: Terrible onboarding experience
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app and was amazed at how good the onboarding was, until very late in the onboarding I was forced to hit a button to leave a rating for the app (why would I rate the app when I haven’t even used it yet????), hitting this button didn’t seem to do anything though, so I’m unsure if that was a bug or if the developers have removed the functionality for this button (if so please remove this screen, it’s against apples terms to ask for a rating / review during onboarding).

To make matters worse, right at the end of onboarding you are hit with a paywall screen, fine, no problem I thought, I’ll skip it (many other apps give you the option to skip and you then use a more basic version of the app) but no, you don’t get that here, you either pay or can fill out a form if you can’t afford it, what if I just want to check out the app though to see if it’s right for me? 

At the very least offer a trial, because some of us may be able to afford the subscription but not want to pay before we’ve used the app and seen whether it’s to our liking or not.

reviews.title: Quite disappointed actually
reviews.text: Quite frankly, I’m very disappointed in the app, definitely not worth paying money for that’s for sure. I thought at least it will count Sunnah and extra prayers, but it doesn't. Also very buggy and it became very annoying to use. The Kibbler compass also is completely wrong 95% of the time

reviews.title: Dude fix the tracking feature
reviews.text: When I confirm that I completed my a prayer, it does not always register. It shows that I did, but when I check back, it’s like I didn’t do it. I can’t track my progress with a dysfunctional feature. I’ll change this review to 5 stars once it’s fixed.

reviews.title: Why is it a subscription
reviews.text: If you’re making an app about prayer tracking I’m pretty sure you’d want to make it free. And teens who have no money can pay for it and I can’t do anything about it. I have to keep searching and if your going to tell me I have to pay atleast tell me it first thing

reviews.title: Buggy & Overpriced
reviews.text: While the concept is nice, the app seems to still be in the beta stages. There are a dozen other apps that successfully execute the same features on beautiful interfaces, without the issues, and a fraction of the price. So I’m not sure how someone would in good conscience feel comfortable charging so much for an app that, at the bare minimum, doesn’t preform as advertised. Issues referenced on a review in January have still not been fixed (prayer tracking isn’t cohesive through the app - must track prayers in journal and on Home Screen) plus some. Again, until the app actually operates as advertised it seems like a money grab to charge people for an app that essentially isn’t working. Especially an app of religious nature and during this holy month. Hopefully they resolve these issues and even still the price is adjusted to be more competitive.

reviews.title: Not value for money
reviews.text: I’d really not like to think that this app is a scam as the the creator has been receptive to emails but at the same time hasn’t provided a solution. I paid for an annual subscription and only got a day to use it. Since purchase, it is permanently stuck on the onboarding page and asks me subscribe. This means I don’t actually have access to the app and cannot use it. As the creator has denied to refund not fix it, I’ve accepted the money paid as sadaqah. My opinion is that it’s a good idea but not ready for use yet. They need to reiterate and at this point should not be charging for what seems to still be in testing.
